meta_path_values.artifact_update: A retained execution/training artifact changes; modification of the improver is not established.
meta_path_values.improvement_memory: Persistent memory or instructions inform future improvement decisions; not automatically optimizer-code rewriting.
meta_path_values.learned_update_policy: The policy generating learning signals or edits is explicitly optimized for their downstream utility.
meta_path_values.self_modifying_improver: Retained executable changes participate in subsequent self-improvement; scope and outer controls still matter.
meta_path_values.not_applicable: Survey, evaluation study, benchmark, or supporting verifier; not classified as a recursive improver.
